# MSD Bow (Xiamen Meisida Decoration Co., Ltd.)

> Ribbon and bow manufacturer in Xiamen, China. Custom satin, grosgrain, printed and
> holiday ribbon, hand-tied bows and gift packaging for retail chains, wholesalers and
> importers. Founded 2007, exporting to more than 80 countries, with a 6,000 m² factory
> and 120 workers. Certifications: BSCI, OEKO-TEX, FSC, GRS.

## Product programmes

- Ribbon
- Ribbon Bow
- Printed Ribbon
- Holiday Ribbon
- Polypropylene Series
- Gift Packing

## Ordering facts

- Custom Pantone colours: minimum 2,000 yards per colour and width
- 196 standard satin and grosgrain colourways are available in smaller quantities
- Free samples on request
- OEM / ODM development from artwork, including Pantone colour matching
